canDoYue: 你識喺行李轉盤報失、描述個袋、講行李牌號碼、填索償表，同埋要求送到酒店。
canDoEn: Report a missing bag at baggage claim, describe it, give the tag number, complete a claim form, and ask for delivery to your hotel.

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: My luggage is missing at baggage claim, because the belt has stopped and my bag never came out.
dialogue.glossYue: 我件行李喺行李轉盤唔見咗，因為條帶停咗，袋又冇出嚟。
dialogue.say: My luggage is missing at baggage claim, because the belt has stopped and my bag never came out.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: Could you describe the bag for me, and tell me the colour if you still remember it?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以同我描述個袋，如果你記得，話我知顏色？
dialogue.say: Could you describe the bag for me, and tell me the colour if you still remember it?

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: It is a blue suitcase with a red ribbon, and it has two small wheels underneath it.
dialogue.glossYue: 係一個藍色喼，綁住紅絲帶，底下一對細轆。
dialogue.say: It is a blue suitcase with a red ribbon, and it has two small wheels underneath it.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: What is the tag number on the handle, so I can search the system for that bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 手柄上面嗰個行李牌號碼係幾多，等我可以喺系統搵個袋？
dialogue.say: What is the tag number on the handle, so I can search the system for that bag?

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: The tag number is HK four eight two, and it was tied onto the suitcase handle yesterday morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 行李牌號碼係 HK 四八二，昨朝綁喺喼手柄。
dialogue.say: The tag number is HK four eight two, and it was tied onto the suitcase handle yesterday morning.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: Please complete this claim form with me, because the bag is not on the belt this evening.
dialogue.glossYue: 今晚個袋唔喺條帶上面，請同我填呢張索償表。
dialogue.say: Please complete this claim form with me, because the bag is not on the belt this evening.

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: Could you deliver the bag to my hotel if you find it after you finish this search?
dialogue.glossYue: 你搵完之後如果搵到個袋，可唔可以送到我間酒店？
dialogue.say: Could you deliver the bag to my hotel if you find it after you finish this search?

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: We can deliver it straight to your hotel when the evening truck leaves the main airport building.
dialogue.glossYue: 今晚架車離開機場大樓嗰陣，我哋可以直接送到你間酒店。
dialogue.say: We can deliver it straight to your hotel when the evening truck leaves the main airport building.
